weights.note: frozen BASE weights; the deck31b repo does not redistribute them

licence.notes: Server code is Apache-2.0 (LICENSE file, README). Base weights remain under Google's Gemma terms (README: "The base weights remain under the Gemma Terms of Use"); the Gemma 4 31B HF card lists Apache-2.0 and links the Gemma 4 licence page.

jev_distillation.evidence: "deck31b is a frozen decision model. ... We did not train them and this repository does not redistribute them." (README)

installer_policy.reason: Frozen unmodified Google base, no training, no Jev outputs. Gemma terms apply to the base weights, which the installer downloads from HF.

readout.notes: Own server (deck31b-serve, 127.0.0.1:8090): TorchAO FP8 dynamic quant at startup, next-token probability mass over option letters with T=3.4 (Cygnet recipe). No tokens generated. Not a logprobs API call, so not portable to llama.cpp/MLX as is.
readout.portable_notes: No portable variant: frozen Gemma-4-31B-it, CUDA hard-coded and TorchAO FP8 dynamic runtime required. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krishna-gogineni-765/deck31b/d499cf6f56ca7b2fd6c74b5f2125bfe960fe0c53/src/deck31b/serve.py L93: BASE_MODEL, revision=BASE_REVISION, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="cuda"; L216: if not torch.cuda.is_available():. BF16 base weights are 62.546 GB (~58.25 GiB); +25% =78.18 GB (~72.8 GiB), before OS allocation. A 64 GB Mac cannot fit this BF16 model. A higher-memory Mac would still require changes to the author server; 31B CPU execution is not a practical interactive installer.

steps: git clone github.com/krishna-gogineni-765/deck31b @ d499cf6f (tree 44bd5211); pip install requirements.txt (torch 2.11.0+cu128, transformers 5.17.0, torchao 0.18.0).
Download google/gemma-4-31B-it @ 842da379 (first start downloads the base).
deck31b-serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8090 (served id deck31b); adapter jevbench typesafe, endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8090, timeout 120 s.

measured.gpu: NVIDIA H100 80GB (BH meta.json gpu H100; deck31b README: one NVIDIA H100 80 GB)

variants.expected_speed: About 0.13 s p 50 per decision on the BH H 100 (raw, serial). Provisioning class: H 100 80 GB; this names a memory class, not a latency measurement or confirmation of architecture compatibility. CPU/Mac speed is estimated only in separate portable variants.
variants.notes: min_vram_gb 80 is from the README ("at least 80 GB of memory") and BH meta. Blackwell (RTX PRO 6000) is unverified for TorchAO FP8 dynamic per BH meta (deck-31b-pro is a separate recipe, not used here). Base bf16 weights 62.58 GB on disk. Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 62.546 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 80 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more.
